subject: General Science
question_en: Which type of mirror/lens or physical principle is used in 'Concave Mirror (focal length sign)'?
question_hi: 'Concave Mirror (focal length sign)' में किस प्रकार के दर्पण/लेंस अथवा भौतिक सिद्धांत का अनुप्रयोग होता है?
explanation: Concave Mirror (focal length sign): Always Negative (-). Concept: In Cartesian sign convention, focal length of concave mirror and concave lens is always negative..

subject: General Science
question_en: Which type of mirror/lens or physical principle is used in 'Convex Mirror (focal length sign)'?
question_hi: 'Convex Mirror (focal length sign)' में किस प्रकार के दर्पण/लेंस अथवा भौतिक सिद्धांत का अनुप्रयोग होता है?

subject: General Science
question_en: Which type of mirror/lens or physical principle is used in 'Rear-view mirrors in automobiles'?
question_hi: 'Rear-view mirrors in automobiles' में किस प्रकार के दर्पण/लेंस अथवा भौतिक सिद्धांत का अनुप्रयोग होता है?
explanation: Rear-view mirrors in automobiles: Convex Mirror. Concept: Provides a wider field of view and forms an erect, diminished virtual image of following traffic..

subject: General Science
question_en: Which type of mirror/lens or physical principle is used in 'Headlights and searchlights reflector'?
question_hi: 'Headlights and searchlights reflector' में किस प्रकार के दर्पण/लेंस अथवा भौतिक सिद्धांत का अनुप्रयोग होता है?
explanation: Headlights and searchlights reflector: Concave Mirror. Concept: Light source placed at the focus produces a strong parallel beam of light..

subject: General Science
question_en: Which type of mirror/lens or physical principle is used in 'Dental inspection mirrors'?
question_hi: 'Dental inspection mirrors' में किस प्रकार के दर्पण/लेंस अथवा भौतिक सिद्धांत का अनुप्रयोग होता है?
explanation: Dental inspection mirrors: Concave Mirror. Concept: Produces an enlarged, erect virtual image when tooth is held within focal length (between P and F)..

subject: General Science
question_en: Which type of mirror/lens or physical principle is used in 'Solar furnace concentrators'?
question_hi: 'Solar furnace concentrators' में किस प्रकार के दर्पण/लेंस अथवा भौतिक सिद्धांत का अनुप्रयोग होता है?
explanation: Solar furnace concentrators: Large Concave Mirror. Concept: Focuses parallel sun rays at the principal focus generating high temperature..

subject: General Science
question_en: Which type of mirror/lens or physical principle is used in 'Power of Lens formula'?
question_hi: 'Power of Lens formula' में किस प्रकार के दर्पण/लेंस अथवा भौतिक सिद्धांत का अनुप्रयोग होता है?
explanation: Power of Lens formula: P = 1 / f (in metres). Concept: SI unit is Dioptre (D). 1 D is the power of a lens of focal length 1 metre..

subject: General Science
question_en: Which type of mirror/lens or physical principle is used in 'Convex lens power sign'?
question_hi: 'Convex lens power sign' में किस प्रकार के दर्पण/लेंस अथवा भौतिक सिद्धांत का अनुप्रयोग होता है?
explanation: Convex lens power sign: Positive (+D). Concept: Because convex lens has a positive focal length (converging lens)..

subject: General Science
question_en: Which type of mirror/lens or physical principle is used in 'Concave lens power sign'?
question_hi: 'Concave lens power sign' में किस प्रकार के दर्पण/लेंस अथवा भौतिक सिद्धांत का अनुप्रयोग होता है?
explanation: Concave lens power sign: Negative (-D). Concept: Because concave lens has a negative focal length (diverging lens)..

subject: General Science
question_en: Which type of mirror/lens or physical principle is used in 'Correction for Myopia (Near-sightedness)'?
question_hi: 'Correction for Myopia (Near-sightedness)' में किस प्रकार के दर्पण/लेंस अथवा भौतिक सिद्धांत का अनुप्रयोग होता है?
explanation: Correction for Myopia (Near-sightedness): Concave Lens. Concept: Myopic eye forms image in front of retina; concave lens diverges incoming rays onto retina..

subject: General Science
question_en: Which type of mirror/lens or physical principle is used in 'Correction for Hypermetropia (Far-sightedness)'?
question_hi: 'Correction for Hypermetropia (Far-sightedness)' में किस प्रकार के दर्पण/लेंस अथवा भौतिक सिद्धांत का अनुप्रयोग होता है?
explanation: Correction for Hypermetropia (Far-sightedness): Convex Lens. Concept: Hypermetropic eye forms image behind retina; convex lens converges rays properly onto retina..

subject: General Science
question_en: Which type of mirror/lens or physical principle is used in 'Presbyopia defect'?
question_hi: 'Presbyopia defect' में किस प्रकार के दर्पण/लेंस अथवा भौतिक सिद्धांत का अनुप्रयोग होता है?
explanation: Presbyopia defect: Bifocal Lens. Concept: Age-related defect where eye loses power of accommodation; upper part is concave, lower part is convex..

subject: General Science
question_en: Which type of mirror/lens or physical principle is used in 'Astigmatism correction'?
question_hi: 'Astigmatism correction' में किस प्रकार के दर्पण/लेंस अथवा भौतिक सिद्धांत का अनुप्रयोग होता है?
explanation: Astigmatism correction: Cylindrical Lens. Concept: Caused by irregular curvature of cornea, corrected using cylindrical lens..

subject: General Science
question_en: Which type of mirror/lens or physical principle is used in 'Twinkling of stars'?
question_hi: 'Twinkling of stars' में किस प्रकार के दर्पण/लेंस अथवा भौतिक सिद्धांत का अनुप्रयोग होता है?
explanation: Twinkling of stars: Atmospheric Refraction. Concept: Due to continuous variation in refractive index of changing atmospheric air layers..

subject: General Science
question_en: Which type of mirror/lens or physical principle is used in 'Blue color of clear sky'?
question_hi: 'Blue color of clear sky' में किस प्रकार के दर्पण/लेंस अथवा भौतिक सिद्धांत का अनुप्रयोग होता है?
explanation: Blue color of clear sky: Rayleigh Scattering of Light. Concept: Scattering is inversely proportional to fourth power of wavelength (1/λ⁴); blue scatters most..

subject: General Science
question_en: Which type of mirror/lens or physical principle is used in 'Red color of sun during sunrise and sunset'?
question_hi: 'Red color of sun during sunrise and sunset' में किस प्रकार के दर्पण/लेंस अथवा भौतिक सिद्धांत का अनुप्रयोग होता है?
explanation: Red color of sun during sunrise and sunset: Scattering of Light. Concept: Red light has longer wavelength, scatters least and penetrates thick atmospheric distance..

subject: General Science
question_en: What is the correct value, law or property for: 'Ohm's Law formula'?
question_hi: 'Ohm's Law formula' के लिए सही मान, नियम अथवा गुणधर्म क्या है?
explanation: Ohm's Law formula: V = I × R. At constant temperature, potential difference (V) is directly proportional to electric current (I)..

subject: General Science
question_en: What is the correct value, law or property for: 'SI unit of Electric Resistance'?
question_hi: 'SI unit of Electric Resistance' के लिए सही मान, नियम अथवा गुणधर्म क्या है?
explanation: SI unit of Electric Resistance: Ohm (Ω). R = V / I. 1 Ohm = 1 Volt / 1 Ampere..

subject: General Science
question_en: What is the correct value, law or property for: 'SI unit of Resistivity (ρ)'?
question_hi: 'SI unit of Resistivity (ρ)' के लिए सही मान, नियम अथवा गुणधर्म क्या है?
explanation: SI unit of Resistivity (ρ): Ohm-metre (Ω·m). R = ρ·L / A; hence ρ = R·A / L (Ω·m² / m = Ω·m)..

subject: General Science
question_en: What is the correct value, law or property for: 'Resistance when wire length is doubled and area halved'?
question_hi: 'Resistance when wire length is doubled and area halved' के लिए सही मान, नियम अथवा गुणधर्म क्या है?
explanation: Resistance when wire length is doubled and area halved: Becomes 4 times. R ∝ L/A. If L -> 2L and A -> A/2, R' = ρ(2L)/(A/2) = 4(ρL/A) = 4R..

subject: General Science
question_en: What is the correct value, law or property for: 'Heating effect of electric current (Joule's Law)'?
question_hi: 'Heating effect of electric current (Joule's Law)' के लिए सही मान, नियम अथवा गुणधर्म क्या है?
explanation: Heating effect of electric current (Joule's Law): H = I² · R · t. Heat produced in resistor is directly proportional to square of current, resistance, and time..

subject: General Science
question_en: What is the correct value, law or property for: '1 Kilowatt-hour (1 kWh) in Joules'?
question_hi: '1 Kilowatt-hour (1 kWh) in Joules' के लिए सही मान, नियम अथवा गुणधर्म क्या है?
explanation: 1 Kilowatt-hour (1 kWh) in Joules: 3.6 × 10⁶ Joules (3.6 MJ). 1 kWh = 1,000 W × 3,600 s = 3,600,000 J..

explanation: Each letter is coded by its opposite alphabet letter (sum of alphabetical positions is 27): R(18)<->I(9), O(15)<->L(12), S(19)<->H(8), E(5)<->V(22). For TULIP: T(20)<->G(7), U(21)<->F(6), L(12)<->O(15), I(9)<->R(18), P(16)<->K(11) -> GFORK.

subject: Reasoning Ability
question_en: Pointing to a photograph of a boy, Suresh said, 'He is the only son of the only son of my mother.' How is Suresh related to that boy?
question_hi: एक लड़के की तस्वीर की ओर इशारा करते हुए सुरेश ने कहा, 'वह मेरी माँ के इकलौते पुत्र का इकलौता पुत्र है।' सुरेश उस लड़के से किस प्रकार संबंधित है?
explanation: Suresh's mother's only son is Suresh himself. The boy is the only son of Suresh. Hence, Suresh is the father of the boy.

subject: Reasoning Ability
question_en: A man walks 5 km South, then turns left and walks 3 km. Then he turns left and walks 5 km. In which direction and how far is he from his starting point?
question_hi: एक व्यक्ति 5 किमी दक्षिण की ओर चलता है, फिर बाएँ मुड़कर 3 किमी चलता है। फिर वह बाएँ मुड़कर 5 किमी चलता है। वह अपने प्रारंभिक बिंदु से किस दिशा में और कितनी दूरी पर है?
explanation: South 5 km, then Left turns him East 3 km, then Left turns him North 5 km (cancelling the South 5 km). Net position is 3 km East.

subject: Reasoning Ability
question_en: Find the missing number in the sequence: 4, 9, 25, 49, 121, 169, ?
explanation: The sequence represents squares of consecutive prime numbers: 2²=4, 3²=9, 5²=25, 7²=49, 11²=121, 13²=169, 17²=289.

subject: Reasoning Ability
question_en: In a row of 40 students, Rohan's rank is 17th from the left end. What is his rank from the right end?
question_hi: 40 विद्यार्थियों की एक पंक्ति में, रोहन का स्थान बाएँ छोर से 17वाँ है। दाएँ छोर से उसका स्थान क्या होगा?
explanation: Total = Left + Right - 1 -> 40 = 17 + Right - 1 -> Right = 40 - 16 = 24th.
